blocks.text: Chuchu left his home once again, but this time, he will never be back. If you scroll deeper into your TikTok FYP, you’ll likely come across a cat owner holding a hanger—or any object he can find—to fetch his cat, who loves strolling around before making his way home. Chuchu, the viral TikTok cat who often roamed around his condo complex and was always fetched by his fur parent, left his online fur parents heartbroken as he finally rested after facing complications with his urinary system.
